entry.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
entry.summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

entry.title: Walmart’s Flipkart is quietly building a food delivery challenger in India
entry.summary: Flipkart has expanded access to its food-delivery service to thousands of employees ahead of its public launch.

entry.title: Blackwall quadruples valuation to $2.2B as websites wrangle an increasingly crowded internet
entry.summary: Blackwall has raised $100M at a $2.2B valuation to continue building security and filtering tools that help websites grapple with growing bot and AI traffic.

entry.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
entry.summary: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation. […]

entry.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
entry.summary: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.

entry.title: Oura adds new fitness metrics to show how workouts impact your body
entry.summary: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman are emerging to dethrone it, putting pressure on the company to keep innovating. By launching more advanced workout metrics, Oura is looking to differentiate itself from competitors as the smart ring market gets more crowded.

entry.title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content
entry.summary: Spotify's new paid memberships let podcasters offer fans exclusive perks, including ad-free listening, early access, and bonus content, while keeping 90% of the revenue.

entry.title: Inspired Capital closes $450M fourth fund as New York pushes back on Silicon Valley’s gravitational pull
entry.summary: The raise comes as venture dollars pile up on the West Coast.

entry.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
entry.summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

entry.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
entry.summary: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

entry.title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation
entry.summary: Reliable Robotics extended its Series D round with $115 million in equity and $25 million in debt.

entry.title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
entry.summary: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.

entry.title: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, but executives reportedly failed to act
entry.summary: Court documents show TikTok employees were frustrated with how executives responded to their concerns about risks to children.

entry.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
entry.summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

entry.title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself
entry.summary: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.

entry.title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in it’s LEGO era’
entry.summary: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

entry.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
entry.summary: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

entry.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
entry.summary: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

entry.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
entry.summary: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

entry.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
entry.summary: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.
